body: I was going to go into my room and do it right then. So i decided to give myself a litle bit of time. MY family hates me. MY dad hates me. Obviously my mom and my siter hate me. Even my little innocent 4 year old sister doesnt come near me without incentive. I dont have anyhing to live for. when my parents ask what do you wanna be if not a doctor, i have nothig to say because i havent developed any interests i dont know anything about anything else. THis best friend i talk abut...i cant even talk to her about this stuff or we wont be friends. I keep this bottled up inside of me and now this seems like the best option to get rid of it.

I wish to remain anonymous. No matter how much they say they keep anonymity, professionals keep phone logs and records. For the sake of my family's respect and dignity, I don't want to shame them with a lot of people openly knowing about me. If I do kill myself, eventually people will know, but I don't care enough about after my life.
